profile_summary: Azure Data Engineer with 2.5 YOE specializing in Azure Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, and ADF within enterprise Medallion Lakehouses. Engineered scalable batch and real-time streaming architectures (Apache Kafka, ADLS Gen2, Unity Catalog) processing 2M+ events/day into Bronze, Silver, and Gold Delta tables with sub-second latency. Automated DataOps CI/CD release cycles and infrastructure provisioning via Terraform, cutting ETL execution runtime by 35% and sustaining 99.95% cloud data platform availability.

technical_competencies.Data Platforms & Lakehouse: Azure Databricks, PySpark (Spark SQL), Delta Lake (ACID, Time Travel, Liquid Clustering), Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, ADLS Gen2, Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold).
technical_competencies.Streaming & Databases: Apache Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, MongoDB, advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs), Star Schema Data Modeling.
technical_competencies.Cloud & DataOps: Terraform (IaC), AWS (EKS, VPC, IAM), Docker, Helm, Jenkins CI/CD, GitLab CI, Linux/Bash, Git.
technical_competencies.Observability & Governance: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Logstash Grok), Data Quality Gates, Unity Catalog concepts.
